scope: 42 simultaneous-intervention conditions, all four prespecified positive observation times; no refitting to ABM outcomes
advantage_update: Gaussian-Poisson: h=0.3, mu=1, r=10; no replacement by uniform redraw
initial_projection: Preserve empirical joint wealth-score state and original B50/M40/T10 labels; no factorization

theory_ABM_acceptance.interval: two-sided pointwise 95% Student-t, df=5, paired differences across six independent initial roots; ABM futures averaged first within root
theory_ABM_acceptance.outside: entire confidence interval strictly outside tolerance window
theory_ABM_acceptance.inconclusive: otherwise; not relabeled as supported merely because interval overlaps zero

numerical_convergence_diagnostic: Report fine-minus-medium differences for every root, condition, time and metric. Flag mean grid shifts exceeding one-quarter of the acceptance tolerance; this is a diagnostic budget, not the original statistical equivalence rule.
multiplicity: Pointwise intervals, not simultaneous 95% coverage over the parameter grid.
ancillary_rank_correlation: Grid midrank correlation recorded without claiming an original precision threshold for R_uw.
scope_exclusions: late-retagging experiments are a distinct initial-state design
no certification of continuous time between observed checkpoints
no universal steady-state or thermodynamic-limit claims
conditional_sampling_extension: Fixed extension from 8 to 16 futures for ALL 42 conditions and all 6 roots, not only favorable parameter points; preparation remains inference unit.

extra_refinement_policy.neutral: All six chi values and all six roots: exact score-integrated lambda=0 solver at dlogw=.01,.005,.0025. Equality at .01 is checked against the full 96-bin calculation.
extra_refinement_policy.nonzero_selection: All six roots and all four positive observation times for every (lambda=.5, chi>0) condition and the Stage-6 reference (4,.03): dlogw=.005, score_bins=96.
extra_refinement_policy.final_theory_selection: Use the finest computed wealth grid for each complete parameter condition. Refinement was triggered by numerical sensitivity; no per-time/per-metric selection by agreement. Retain the full uniform-grid baseline.
